Member the Timex Sinclair 1000? i even had the 16k expansion pack!
Yup, I remember 'em, but never had one myself ... or knew anyone who did. Good oldie from the dark days when we were all just figuring this stuff out as we went along.

I bought a Sinclair ZX80 + 16K RAM pack in December 1980. Sinclair wrote to me in January '81 with a preprinted advert for the ZX81 and offered me that instead if I was willing to wait until March when the new machine would be released. I agreed and received an Issue 1 ZX81 as soon as the machines were released. They weren't even reviewed in magazines until a month after I got mine. Annoyingly, the RAM pack didn't arrive at the same time so I had the '81 for three months with just 1K of RAM which was hard work and when the RAM pack did arrive it was labelled as a ZX80 RAM pack even though it was black which I thought was odd. I learned a lot programming on that machine until my parents made me sell it because the teachers at school said I was wasting my time and there was no future in computers. 35 years later that's how I earn a 6 figure salary. Shows what they knew.
